use_case_summary: Atomize CodeFlux is building an in-IDE copilot that requires sub-100ms tail latency for token completions, streaming responses for interactive code edits, and robust model/version pinning so customers can freeze a model per workspace. Offline workflows include high-throughput embedding refresh (2M files nightly or incremental delta updates) and a real-time indexing pipeline for search/rerank. They want recommendations for batching, KV/prefix caching and quantization tradeoffs to hit cost targets.
technical_requirements: Targets: 80k tokens/sec embedding throughput for nightly refresh (distributed), live completion SLO: p95 < 80ms, p99 < 200ms at 100 concurrent devs per org. Need rolling model rollouts, canary A/B, and automatic fallback to cheaper variant under capacity pressure. Must support SSO (SAML), audit logs, customer-managed KMS, and EU data residency. POC dataset + ingest scripts available in drive link.
